title: ARGUS - AI Agent Intelligence (Powered by SigNoz)
description: Real-time AI agent governance dashboard. Queries actual SigNoz trace data stored in ClickHouse — no custom instrumentation required. All panels use the gen_ai.request.model and argus.* span attributes emitted by the ARGUS Python SDK.

panels.title: Agent Traces Over Time
panels.description: Agent trace volume by service. Shows how many agent executions are being tracked.

panels.title: LLM Models Used by Agents
panels.description: Distribution of LLM models used by agents. Data comes from gen_ai.request.model span attributes.

panels.title: Estimated Cost by Agent (Last 24h)
panels.description: Estimated LLM cost per agent. Uses argus.execution.cost span attributes emitted by the SDK.

panels.title: Governance Violation Events
panels.description: Governance violations detected by the ARGUS engine. Shows rule type, agent, and frequency.

panels.title: Recent Agent Spans
panels.description: Most recent spans from agent executions, showing tool calls, LLM invocations, and governance events.

panels.title: Active Agents (Last 30m)
panels.description: Number of unique agents active in the last 30 minutes.
